"></div>
<img id="sea" alt="Sea, a tabby cat wearing a neon-green hood and octopus pendant" draggable="false" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
<div id="speech" aria-live="polite" class="from-sea"><span id="speechName" class="speakerName">SEA</span><span id="speechLine">That noise was... probably normal.</span></div>
<div id="buttonRing"></div>
<div id="status" aria-live="polite"></div><div id="toast"></div>
<div id="board" aria-label="Three-lane dodge challenge"><div id="boardHead">⚠ INCOMING <span id="hazardName"></span></div><div id="lanes"><div class="lane"><b>LEFT</b><span class="laneArrow">⬅️</span><small>SAFE</small></div><div class="lane"><b>CENTER</b><span class="laneArrow">⬇️</span><small>SAFE</small></div><div class="lane"><b>RIGHT</b><span class="laneArrow">➡️</span><small>SAFE</small></div><div id="incoming">🪣</div></div><div id="boardFoot">LOOK FOR GREEN!</div><div id="boardClock"><i></i></div><div id="boardResult"></div></div>
<div id="panicPanel"><h2>🚨 PANIC DECISION</h2><div id="panicClock">3.0</div><small>NOOSH IS COMING</small></div>
<div id="stageLabel">STAGE 2 • DO NOT PRESS</div>
</section>
<div id="powers" class="hidden"><button id="puppy">🥺 Puppy Eyes 30</button><button id="raccoons">🦝 Raccoons 60</button><button id="rage">🍗 Nuggie Rage 100</button></div>
<footer id="bottom"><div id="copy"><div id="kicker">UTW INCIDENT IN PROGRESS</div><div id="speaker">SEA</div><div id="story">That noise was... probably normal.</div></div><div id="actions"></div></footer>
<section id="guide" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Stage 2 help"><button type="button" id="closeGuide" aria-label="Close help">✕</button><h2>↔️ STAGE 2 · HOW TO PLAY</h2><p>Make your choice, then watch the incoming objects. Move to the <strong style="color:#b2ffd4">GREEN safe lane</strong>. If all three lanes are red, <strong>DUCK</strong>. You can tap the buttons or swipe left, right, or down. Mistakes mean funny consequences, not game over.</p><p style="color:#f8cdad;font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,16px)">This is a separate art trial. Demo energy is provided to try one power.</p><button class="btn" id="guideGo">GOT IT ▶</button></section>
<section id="pauseOverlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><h2>⏸ PAUSED</h2><p>No timer runs while the game is paused.</p><button class="btn" id="resume">RESUME ▶</button><button class="btn secondary" id="restartPause">RESTART STAGE ↻</button></section>
<section id="endOverlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><h2>🎀 STAGE 2 COMPLETE</h2><p id="endSummary"></p><p id="endOutro">Something just ran away with the train keys...</p><button class="btn" id="replay">REPLAY STAGE 2 ↻</button></section>
</main><script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),rnd=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a),max=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const dialogue=[['Sea','That noise was... probably normal.'],['Tiny','Why is there a button under the throne?'],['Sea','Only one way to find out.'],['Tiny','It specifically says DO NOT PRESS.'],['Sea','Those sound like suggestions to me.']];
const patterns=[{name:'CHANDELIER',emoji:'💡',direction:'overhead'}, {name:'BUCKET',emoji:'🪣',direction:'side'}, {name:'ALARM CART',emoji:'🚨',direction:'side'}, {name:'FLYING MOP',emoji:'🧹',direction:'overhead'}, {name:'CRATE',emoji:'📦',direction:'side'}];
const startingState=()=>({phase:'dialogue',idx:0,score:0,energy:35,misses:0,perfects:0,evidence:false,button:null,panic:null,round:0,hazards:[],clock:0,duration:0,wait:0,flash:'',shield:0,auto:0,rage:0,paused:false,sound:false,done:false});
let g=startingState(),prevTime=0,raf=0,ctx=null,toastTimer=0,runId=0;
function note(type='tap'){
 if(!g.sound)return;try{ctx||=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const osc=ctx.createOscillator(),vol=ctx.createGain();const sound={tap:[480,.07,'triangle'],success:[810,.13,'sine'],bonk:[170,.16,'sawtooth'],alarm:[290,.14,'sawtooth'],power:[960,.15,'sine']}[type]||[480,.07,'triangle'];osc.type=sound[2];osc.frequency.value=sound[0];vol.gain.setValueAtTime(.05,ctx.currentTime);vol.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ctx.currentTime+sound[1]);osc.connect(vol);vol.connect(ctx.destination);osc.start();osc.stop(ctx.currentTime+sound[1])}catch{}
}
function mark(text,ms=1600){$('toast').textContent=text;$('toast').style.display='block';clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').style.display='none',ms)}
function hud(){$('chaos').textContent=g.score.toLocaleString();$('energy').textContent=g.energy;$('energyBar').style.width=g.energy+'%';for(const [id,cost] of [['puppy',30],['raccoons',60],['rage',100]])$(id).disabled=g.energy<cost||g.paused}
function power(amt){g.energy=max(g.energy+amt,0,100);hud()}
function score(amt){g.score+=amt;hud()}
function story(name,words,kicker='UTW INCIDENT IN PROGRESS'){$('speaker').textContent=name.toUpperCase();$('story').textContent=words;$('kicker').textContent=kicker;
 $('speechName').textContent=name.toUpperCase();$('speechLine').textContent=words;const sp=$('speech');sp.className='from-'+name.toLowerCase();sp.classList.toggle('hidden',g.phase==='dodge'||g.phase==='panic'||g.phase==='reaction')}
function buttons(rows){$('actions').replaceChildren();for(const [label,fn,secondary] of rows){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn'+(secondary?' secondary':'');b.textContent=label;b.onclick=()=>{if(g.paused)return;note();fn()};$('actions').append(b)}}
function phase(p){g.phase=p;document.body.dataset.phase=p;$('scene').className=p==='panic'?'panic':p==='dodge'||p==='reaction'?'dodge':p==='buttonChoice'?'button-choice':'';$('powers').classList.toggle('hidden',!['panic','dodge','reaction'].includes(p));$('speech').classList.toggle('hidden',['panic','dodge','reaction'].includes(p));$('board').classList.toggle('show',p==='dodge'||p==='reaction');$('panicPanel').classList.toggle('show',p==='panic');hud()}
function opening(){phase('dialogue');g.idx=0;nextLine()}
function nextLine(){if(g.idx>=dialogue.length){buttonChoice();return}const [who,line]=dialogue[g.idx++];story(who,line,'THE FORBIDDEN BUTTON • '+g.idx+'/'+dialogue.length);buttons([['NEXT ▶',nextLine,false]])}
function buttonChoice(){phase('buttonChoice');story('Tiny','All answers are technically terrible.','HOW SHOULD TINY INVESTIGATE?');buttons([['POKE IT',()=>press('poke')],['USE MY ELBOW',()=>press('elbow'),true],['MAKE SEA DO IT',()=>press('sea'),true]])}
function press(choice){g.button=choice;score(choice==='sea'?100:140);power(12);note('alarm');story(choice==='sea'?'Sea':'Tiny',choice==='sea'?'Wait. Why am I suddenly responsible?':choice==='elbow'?'Technically my finger never touched it.':'Just a tiny little poke.','ALARM! ALARM!');phase('buttonFlash');g.wait=.8;buttons([]);mark('🔴 THAT WAS PROBABLY EXPENSIVE')}
function panic(){phase('panic');g.duration=3;g.clock=3;story('Tiny','NOOSH WILL BE BACK ANY SECOND!','THINK FAST');buttons([['HIDE THE SIGN',()=>panicResult('hide')],['BLAME SEA',()=>panicResult('blame'),true],['RUN!',()=>panicResult('run')]]);note('alarm')}
function panicResult(choice){if(g.phase!=='panic')return;g.panic=choice;if(choice==='hide')g.evidence=true;score(180);power(10);g.perfects++;const line={hide:'If there is no warning sign, there is no crime.',blame:'Sea: I DID NOT AGREE TO THIS.',run:'STRATEGIC RETREAT!'}[choice];phase('panicOutcome');story(choice==='blame'?'Sea':'Tiny',line,'THE NEXT DISASTER IS LOADING');buttons([]);g.wait=.65;note('success')}
function randomDeck(){const list=patterns.map(p=>{const from=p.direction==='overhead'?'overhead':Math.random()<.5?'left':'right';return {...p,from,correct:from==='overhead'?'DUCK':from==='left'?'RIGHT':'LEFT'}});
 for(let i=list.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[list[i],list[j]]=[list[j],list[i]]}
 try{const key='utw:tiny:stage2:last-deck',sig=list.map(x=>x.name+':'+x.from).join('|'),prev=localStorage.getItem(key);if(sig===prev){[list[0],list[1]]=[list[1],list[0]]}localStorage.setItem(key,list.map(x=>x.name+':'+x.from).join('|'))}catch{}return list}
function beginDodge(i){$('scene').classList.remove('bonk-active');if(i>=5){finish();return}g.round=i;g.phase='dodge';phase('dodge');g.clock=[4.4,4.1,3.8,3.6,3.4][i];g.duration=g.clock;
 const h=g.hazards[i],block=h.correct==='DUCK'?[0,1,2]:h.from==='left'?[0,1]:[1,2];
 $('hazardName').textContent=h.name+' '+(h.from==='overhead'?'⬇️':h.from==='left'?'➡️':'⬅️');
 const lanes=[...$('lanes').querySelectorAll('.lane')];for(let li=0;li<3;li++){lanes[li].classList.toggle('danger',block.includes(li));lanes[li].classList.toggle('safe',!block.includes(li));lanes[li].querySelector('small').textContent=block.includes(li)?'DANGER':'SAFE ✓';lanes[li].querySelector('.laneArrow').textContent=block.includes(li)?'⛔':'✓'}
 $('boardFoot').textContent=h.correct==='DUCK'?'⬇ DUCK! ALL LANES ARE RED':'✅ GREEN LANE: '+h.correct;
 $('incoming').textContent=h.emoji;$('boardResult').className='';$('boardResult').style.display='none';
 story('Tiny','Red means danger. Green is safe.','REFLEX CHALLENGE • '+(i+1)+'/5');buttons([['◀ LEFT',()=>dodge('LEFT'),true],['▼ DUCK',()=>dodge('DUCK')],['RIGHT ▶',()=>dodge('RIGHT'),true]]);drawDodge()}
function drawDodge(){const h=g.hazards[g.round];if(!h||!['dodge','reaction'].includes(g.phase))return;const progress=max(1-g.clock/g.duration,0,1);$('boardClock').firstElementChild.style.width=(100-progress*100)+'%';const incoming=$('incoming');incoming.style.left=(h.from==='left'?3+60*progress:h.from==='right'?97-60*progress:50)+'%';incoming.style.top=(h.from==='overhead'?5+62*progress:34+27*progress)+'%';incoming.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale('+(0.85+progress*.5)+')';}
function dodge(action){if(g.phase!=='dodge')return;const expected=g.hazards[g.round].correct;let success=action===expected;
 if(!success&&g.auto>0){g.auto--;success=true;mark('🦝 THE RACCOONS SAVED YOU!')}
 if(!success&&g.shield>0){g.shield--;success=true;mark('🥺 PUPPY EYES SAVED YOU!')}
 if(success){score(180+(g.rage>0?60:0));power(14);g.perfects++;note('success');story('Tiny','I AM THE DEFINITION OF GRACE.','REFLEX CHALLENGE • '+(g.round+1)+'/5')}
 else{g.misses++;g.evidence=true;note('bonk');const lines=['Sea: That was almost impressive.','Tiny: I meant to do that!','Savvy: *The sigh is getting louder.*'];story(g.round%3===2?'Savvy':'Tiny',lines[g.round%3],'REFLEX CHALLENGE • '+(g.round+1)+'/5')}
 if(g.rage>0)g.rage--;phase('reaction');$('boardResult').textContent=success?'✨ SAFE! NICE DODGE!':'💥 BONK! KEEP GOING!';$('boardResult').className=success?'show':'show hit';$('boardResult').style.display='block';$('scene').classList.add(success?'bonus':'slam');$('scene').classList.toggle('bonk-active',!success);buttons([]);g.wait=.84;}
function finish(){phase('end');$('scene').classList.remove('dodge','bonk-active','slam');$('board').classList.remove('show');story('Tiny','...Why is that crate MOVING?','THE RACCOONS ARE FREE');buttons([]);
 g.done=true;$('endSummary').innerHTML='<strong>'+g.score.toLocaleString()+' CHAOS</strong> · '+g.misses+' INCIDENTS · '+g.perfects+' GOOD MOVES';$('endOverlay').classList.add('show');let b=$('tinyContinueBtn');if(!b){b=document.createElement('button');b.id='tinyContinueBtn';b.className='btn';$('endOverlay').appendChild(b)}b.textContent='CONTINUE TO STAGE 3 ▸';b.onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_STAGE_DONE',stage:2,score:g.score,energy:g.energy,meta:{misses:g.misses,perfects:g.perfects,button:g.button,panic:g.panic,evidence:g.evidence}},'*');mark('🦝 SOMETHING JUST STOLE THE TRAIN KEYS',2600);}
function tick(now){if(!prevTime)prevTime=now;let dt=Math.min(.07,(now-prevTime)/1000);prevTime=now;if(!g.paused){
 if(g.phase==='buttonFlash'||g.phase==='panicOutcome'||g.phase==='reaction'){g.wait-=dt;if(g.wait<=0){if(g.phase==='buttonFlash')panic();else if(g.phase==='panicOutcome'){g.hazards=randomDeck();beginDodge(0)}else if(g.phase==='reaction'){ $('scene').classList.remove('slam','bonus','bonk-active');beginDodge(g.round+1)}}}
 else if(g.phase==='panic'){g.clock-=dt;$('panicClock').textContent=Math.max(0,g.clock).toFixed(1);if(g.clock<=0){g.misses++;g.panic='freeze';phase('panicOutcome');story('Tiny','I HAVE NO IDEA WHAT TO DO.','PANIC DECISION: TIMEOUT');buttons([]);g.wait=.65}}
 else if(g.phase==='dodge'){g.clock-=dt;drawDodge();if(g.clock<=0)dodge('TIMEOUT')}
 }raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
function reset(){g=startingState();if(Number.isFinite(window.__tinyInheritedEnergy))g.energy=window.__tinyInheritedEnergy;runId++;$('endOverlay').classList.remove('show');$('pauseOverlay').classList.remove('show');$('guide').classList.remove('show');$('toast').style.display='none';$('board').classList.remove('show');$('panicPanel').classList.remove('show');$('scene').className='';$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');$('scene').classList.remove('slam','bonus','bonk-active');prevTime=performance.now();hud();opening()}
function setPause(p){g.paused=p;$('pauseOverlay').classList.toggle('show',p);hud();}
function usePower(key){const cost={puppy:30,raccoons:60,rage:100}[key];if(g.paused||g.energy<cost||!['dodge','panic'].includes(g.phase))return;g.energy-=cost;const result={puppy:'🥺 +1.5 SEC / SHIELD',raccoons:'🦝 ONE FREE SAVE',rage:'🍗 EXTRA CHAOS POINTS'}[key];
 if(key==='puppy'){if(g.phase==='panic')g.clock+=1.5;else {g.clock+=1.5;g.duration+=1.5;g.shield++}}else if(key==='raccoons'){g.auto++}else if(key==='rage'){g.rage=2};hud();mark(result);note('power')}
let touch=null;$('scene').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{touch={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}});$('scene').addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(!touch||g.phase!=='dodge')return;const dx=e.clientX-touch.x,dy=e.clientY-touch.y;touch=null;if(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy))<30)return;if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy))dodge(dx<0?'LEFT':'RIGHT');else if(dy>0)dodge('DUCK')});
function closeGuide(){if(!$('guide').classList.contains('show'))return;$('guide').classList.remove('show');g.paused=Boolean(helpWasPaused);prevTime=performance.now();hud()}
$('guideGo').onclick=closeGuide;$('closeGuide').onclick=closeGuide;
let helpWasPaused=false;
$('helpButton').onclick=()=>{if($('guide').classList.contains('show')){closeGuide();return}helpWasPaused=g.paused;g.paused=true;$('pauseOverlay').classList.remove('show');$('guide').classList.add('show');hud()};
$('guide').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.target===$('guide'))closeGuide()});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&$('guide').classList.contains('show'))closeGuide()});
$('pauseButton').onclick=()=>setPause(!g.paused);$('resume').onclick=()=>setPause(false);$('restartPause').onclick=reset;$('replay').onclick=reset;
$('soundButton').onclick=()=>{g.sound=!g.sound;$('soundButton').textContent=g.sound?'🔊':'♫';note('tap')};
$('fullscreen').onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN'},'*');
$('puppy').onclick=()=>usePower('puppy');$('raccoons').onclick=()=>usePower('raccoons');$('rage').onclick=()=>usePower('rage');
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(g.phase!=='dodge')return;const action=({ArrowLeft:'LEFT',ArrowRight:'RIGHT',ArrowDown:'DUCK',a:'LEFT',d:'RIGHT',s:'DUCK'})[e.key];if(action){e.preventDefault();dodge(action)}});
// Do not connect standalone trial to live scoreboards or user accounts.
reset();g.paused=false;$('guide').classList.remove('show');prevTime=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
/* Help instructions remain available from the ? button; no opening speech overlay. */
window.__tinyStage2Test={get:()=>({...g}),choose:press,panic:panicResult,dodge,reset,deck:()=>g.hazards.map(x=>({...x})),skipIntro:buttonChoice,finish:finish};
})();
</script></body></html>
